edge_cases_audited.name: Does customer B's Valider reject Algérienne (per K.3 + pruneUnavailableLines 6f226ef67)?
edge_cases_audited.verdict: PARTIAL — backend rejects (NEW P2 UX finding: client prune does NOT cover extras)
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Sequence: at t=1.0s KioskCartComponent.vue:636-694 proceedToUpsell() fires. Line 652 calls `this.pruneUnavailableLines()` (commit 6f226ef67). HOWEVER, the prune action at resources/js/store/modules/kioskCart.js lines 664-679 filters ONLY on `line.item_id` against `rootState.kioskMenu.items[].is_available` + `status ∈ {0,2}`. It DOES NOT walk `line.item_extras[]` or `line.item_variations[]`. Algérienne is an `ItemExtra` (a sauce option), so a stale cart line with Tacos + extra_id=Algérienne passes the client prune unchanged (cartCount unchanged → no toast → quoteOrder() proceeds). Backend defense fires at t=1.0s+RTT: FrontendOrderService.php:278 routes to PricingService::calculateOrder (config('pricing.use_ssot_service', true) default = true). PricingService.php:546-553 calls ChoiceAvailabilityResolver::assertSelectionsOrderable(branchId=1, dbVariations, dbExtras (includes Algérienne id), dbAddons, surface='kiosk', useRowLock=true). assertSelectionsOrderable line 156-162 reads StockLevel rows under lockForUpdate for the requested extras; line 163-174 throws \InvalidArgumentException("Supplément ID {algerienne_id} indisponible pour cette branche (out_of_stock).", 422). Kiosk surfaces 422 via KioskCartComponent.vue:685-690 catch → `this.quoteError = message; this.showToast(message, 'error', 6000)`. So order IS rejected, but: (a) user sees an ERROR toast (not the friendly `kiosk.unavailable_items_pruned` notice), (b) the cart line is NOT removed (still shows Algérienne), forcing the user to manually re-edit Tacos. The 6f226ef67 fix solved the ITEM-level analog of this exact same UX problem, but the EXTRAS-level analog was not co-shipped. NF525-safe (order rejected before DB commit, no fiscal_sequence_no allocated, no audit_log row) but UX-defective at rush hour.
edge_cases_audited.severity_uplift_note: P1-class if owner weighs rush-hour cashier-needs-to-help-confused-customer cost. The original 6f226ef67 bug report from owner used the same wording ('parfois ça disparait', error toast at panier) that would re-surface here when the unavailable item is an EXTRA instead of a top-level item.
edge_cases_audited.remediation_recommended: Extend pruneUnavailableLines (kioskCart.js:664-679) to ALSO walk each line.item_extras[] / line.item_variations[] and drop the extras whose StockLevel-derived `is_available === false` (data must be projected onto rootState.kioskMenu.items[].item_extras[].is_available — verify projection coverage via KioskMenuService.php:371). When an extra is dropped from a line, the user should be warned to re-select; safer default: drop the whole line (cohérence wizard step) + toast `kiosk.unavailable_items_pruned`. ~25-40 LOC; not in CLAUDE.md §7 frozen zone (KioskCartComponent.vue + kioskCart.js are auditable per `feedback_kiosk_wizard_frozen_tests_allowed.md` — but the WIZARD components themselves are frozen, kioskCart store is not). Owner-gate not required; ship behind feature flag for soak.

edge_cases_audited.name: Does cashier C's encaisser succeed (independent path)?
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Cashier C's path is fully decoupled from customer B's order. PaymentService.php:219-447 confirmCounterPayment runs in its own DB::transaction (line 219) for the OLDER order_id. The transaction acquires Order::lockForUpdate at line 220-223 — this lock is on a DIFFERENT row than customer B's new order would touch (customer B is INSERT-ing a new Order row, not UPDATE-ing the cashier's). No row-level conflict possible. PaymentService.php:321-322 calls FiscalSequenceService::next(branchId=1) inside the transaction → acquires Cache::lock('fiscal_seq_b1', 5s) at FiscalSequenceService.php:66, blocks up to 3s, then runs `Order::withTrashed()->where('branch_id', 1)->lockForUpdate()->max('fiscal_sequence_no') + 1` under DB row-lock. No contention from customer B because customer B's kiosk-CASH order does NOT allocate a fiscal_sequence_no at creation (see K.4.8 evidence — FrontendOrderService.php:266-267 creates the order with payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER, no fiscal_sequence_no payload). So cashier C is the SOLE fiscal_sequence_no allocator in the 0-2s window. Cache::lock acquired immediately, lockForUpdate returns last_max + 1, allocation succeeds. AuditLog write line 389-401 with Cache::lock('audit_chain_b1', 5s) at AuditLogService.php:100-101: no other writer for branch 1 in this window (admin A toggleExtra does NOT write audit_log — grep confirms zero AuditLogService::write call in app/Services/Menu/AvailabilityService.php or app/Http/Controllers/Admin/AvailabilityController.php; customer B's FrontendOrderService::myOrderStore also does NOT write audit_log on create — grep confirms zero call). So audit_chain_b1 lock is uncontested → write succeeds in single attempt (no QueryException retry path at lines 187-188 triggered). recordCashOrderMovement at PaymentService.php:442-444 runs OUTSIDE the DB::transaction (after `if ($paid)` gate at line 408), so its CashDrawerSession::findOpenSessionForUser + recordMovement INSERT cannot race the customer B order INSERT. Event fan-out OrderPaidAtCounter::dispatch at line 409 + OrderStatusChanged conditional at line 421-433 all happen post-commit on the cashier path independently. Cashier C succeeds.

edge_cases_audited.name: Does admin A's toggle persist + Echo broadcast?
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Admin A's toggleExtra path: app/Http/Controllers/Admin/AvailabilityController.php:170 toggleExtra() endpoint → AvailabilityService::toggleExtra at AvailabilityService.php:409-411 delegates to toggleStockable (line 511 shared core). The toggleStockable runs in DB::transaction with StockLevel lockForUpdate (line 530); idempotent re-toggle short-circuit (line 547-548). Event dispatched via dispatchStockableEvent at line 567 inside DB::afterCommit (lines 607-630): `event(new ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged(extraId, branchId, isAvailable, reason))` at line 611-616. $listen mapping at EventServiceProvider.php:214-228 wires ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged → [PersistItemExtraAvailabilityChangedToOutbox, PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox, InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange]. The InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange listener (Q9-S1 fix, commit a68acb20f) — InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange.php:20-47 handle() — forgets `kiosk.menu.branch.{branchId}` cache key (line 72) + bumps MenuSnapshot version. PersistCatalogChangedToOutbox writes domain_events row → DispatchDomainEventsJob → BroadcastManager fires on `private-branch.{branchId}` channel with broadcast_as='CatalogChanged'. Kiosk B's Echo subscription at KioskAppComponent.vue:554-559 onEvents binding handles 'CatalogChanged' → _handleCatalogChanged at lines 745-770 → dispatches kioskMenu/fetchMenu({force:true}) at line 765-767. The full chain works mechanically — but at SOKETI+1015ms baseline, the broadcast arrives at the kiosk at t≈1.335s, ~315ms AFTER customer B's Valider click at t=1.0s. So the persist + broadcast SUCCEED, but customer B's Valider happens BEFORE the kiosk has consumed the broadcast → kioskMenu still has stale `Algérienne is_available=true` at t=1.0s.
edge_cases_audited.timing_window_note: Per Q1 above: backend ChoiceAvailabilityResolver is the ONLY defense in this exact 315ms window. If Soketi is degraded (Pusher protocol fallback to long-poll, or Echo TLS handshake stall), the window stretches further; backend remains the sole guarantor. K.3.1 baseline 1015ms is BEST CASE; PHP-FPM cold-start + queue backlog can extend it to 3-5s under load.

edge_cases_audited.name: NF525 chain stays CHAIN OK throughout?
edge_cases_audited.verdict: VERIFIED CITED — chain has effectively ONE writer in scenario
edge_cases_audited.evidence: audit_logs writers in the 0-2s window for branch_id=1: (a) Admin A toggleExtra → ZERO write (AvailabilityService + AvailabilityController grep returns 0 AuditLogService::write call); (b) Customer B FrontendOrderService::myOrderStore on success → ZERO write (FrontendOrderService.php grep returns 0 AuditLogService or audit_log reference); (c) Cashier C confirmCounterPayment → ONE write (PaymentService.php:389-401 with action='order.counter_payment_confirmed'). So only Cashier C contests audit_chain_b1 in this scenario. AuditLogService::write at AuditLogService.php:100 acquires `Cache::lock('audit_chain_b1', 5s)`, blocks up to 5s (CHAIN_LOCK_WAIT) at line 103. Uncontested → acquires immediately. performInsert at line 134 reads $prevHash = $this->lastHashFor(1) at line 144 then computes $currentHash at line 145, INSERT line 148-160 succeeds first attempt. UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) DB constraint never trips (line 187-188 retry path not entered). Chain proceeds last_hash → cashier_C_audit.current_hash with monotonic order, prev_hash linkage intact. F.10 chain validator at app/Services/Fiscal/FiscalChainValidator.php would re-attest CHAIN OK at any time. No customer-B or admin-A writes interleave, so even an HMAC reordering bug would not manifest in this scenario.
edge_cases_audited.post_scenario_chain_attestation: Run `php artisan fiscal:verify-chain --branch=1` (if exposed) OR `SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(id), MAX(current_hash) FROM audit_logs WHERE branch_id=1` snapshot pre+post window — expect count = pre+1, current_hash advanced by exactly cashier_C row.

edge_cases_audited.name: fiscal_sequence_no allocation race (cashier C + customer B both may allocate)?
edge_cases_audited.verdict: NO RACE EXISTS IN THIS SCENARIO — only cashier C allocates
edge_cases_audited.evidence: Customer B's kiosk-CASH order at CREATION does NOT allocate fiscal_sequence_no. Grep on FrontendOrderService.php for `fiscal_sequence_no` returns only the kiosk-CARD/TICKET finalizePaidKioskOrder path (lines 1153-1159, `if (...config('fiscal.kiosk_auto_allocate_sequence', true))` — auto-allocate for online-paid kiosk). Counter-deferred CASH path (FrontendOrderService.php:266-267) writes the FrontendOrder with payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER + pos_payment_method=COUNTER_DEFERRED but NO fiscal_sequence_no — deferred to PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment at PaymentService.php:321-322 which fires only AT counter-collect, which doesn't happen for customer B in this scenario (B's order stays PENDING_COUNTER through t=2s+). So cashier C is the SOLE allocator. FiscalSequenceService::next at line 66 acquires Cache::lock('fiscal_seq_b1', 5s) uncontested. Per K.4.8 verified at HEAD: confirmCounterPayment allocates 1:1 with money received, so allocation timing 1-second-class instead of seconds-class. WERE there ever a hypothetical second concurrent counter-collect for the SAME branch at the SAME instant, FiscalSequenceService.php:66 + 100 (Cache::lock + lockForUpdate withTrashed) provides triple defense (cache lock + DB row lock + UNIQUE(branch, seq) DB constraint via orders_branch_fiscal_seq_unique migration f1bff8bfd). Z6-P1 LOCK 2026-05-19 hardening (withTrashed at line 98) prevents sequence_no re-use on soft-deleted orders — guaranteed gap-free per branch.
edge_cases_audited.design_note: If owner ever changes config('fiscal.kiosk_auto_allocate_sequence') to allocate at counter-deferred order CREATION (V1.0.X reconsideration), then customer B + cashier C WOULD contest fiscal_seq_b1 in this window. Current design (defer to confirmCounterPayment) avoids the race entirely AND prevents sequence-gap risk when customers walk away. Recommend keeping current behavior.

edge_cases_audited.name: cash_movements race (cashier C records cash)?
edge_cases_audited.verdict: NO RACE EXISTS — cashier C is sole writer + non-blocking design
edge_cases_audited.evidence: cash_movements writers in scenario: (a) Admin A toggleExtra → never touches cash_movements; (b) Customer B FrontendOrderService::myOrderStore → never touches cash_movements (kiosk path is payment-deferred); (c) Cashier C → PaymentService::recordCashOrderMovement at line 472-545 fires at line 442-444 AFTER the DB::transaction commit gate (line 408 `if ($paid)`). The write is single-writer, single-row INSERT (CashDrawerService::recordMovement at PaymentService.php:524-532). recordCashOrderMovement runs in DEFAULT $strict=false mode for kiosk counter-collect (line 442 invocation has no $strict arg → default false). If no open CashDrawerSession exists for cashier C, line 503-517 silent-fail return — no cash_movements row but Order remains PAID + audit_log written + Transaction row written. This is K.4.4 AMBER (V1.0.X backlog). No race with customer B because B never invokes cash_movements. No race with admin A. No conflict from secondary cashier opening drawer simultaneously (CashDrawerService::recordMovement uses straightforward INSERT, no shared lock). Single-writer, conflict-free.

race_window_analysis.scenario_critical_window_description: From admin A's DB commit at t≈0.32s to customer B's Valider at t=1.0s = ~680ms. The Echo broadcast for ItemExtraAvailabilityChanged (admin toggleExtra) requires ~1015ms to reach the kiosk per Q9-S1 baseline. Therefore the broadcast arrives ~335ms AFTER customer B clicks Valider. Kiosk-side `_handleCatalogChanged` fires fetchMenu({force:true}) at ~t=1.335s — too late for B's pre-flight prune. Backend (PricingService → ChoiceAvailabilityResolver) is the SOLE active defense in the 680ms window where the race opens.
race_window_analysis.backend_only_defense_attestation: ChoiceAvailabilityResolver::assertSelectionsOrderable (app/Services/Stock/ChoiceAvailabilityResolver.php:156-174) uses `useRowLock=true` when `orderId > 0`, taking StockLevel lockForUpdate. This means even if admin A's toggleExtra DB::transaction has not yet visibility-propagated to a separate read connection at the exact instant PricingService runs (sub-100ms read-after-write skew on MySQL InnoDB SERIALIZABLE not in use — default REPEATABLE READ + READ COMMITTED for other connections), the lockForUpdate in ChoiceAvailabilityResolver forces serialization at the storage engine layer. Customer B's quote either (a) sees admin A's UPDATE if committed before B's SELECT FOR UPDATE acquires, OR (b) waits for B's lockForUpdate as admin A's tx is still uncommitted. Either way, customer B reads the FINAL is_available state, not a torn read. Race-free at DB layer.
race_window_analysis.soketi_degradation_resilience: If Soketi (Pusher self-host) is degraded — Echo client falls back to long-polling or reconnects mid-broadcast — the broadcast window can stretch 2-5s+. Customer B's prune would be even MORE behind, but backend rejection STILL fires. Same outcome (error toast + 422). NF525 + financial correctness UNAFFECTED by Soketi degradation. Only UX cosmetic friendliness suffers. NEW FINDING: monitoring on Soketi latency would surface degraded UX before customers complain (V1.0.X observability backlog).

concurrent_3way_verdict.data_integrity: GREEN — no double-charge, no duplicate fiscal_sequence_no, no chain fork, no torn read on StockLevel (lockForUpdate forces serialization), no cross-cashier order leak (H2-HEAL-01 user-scoped idempotency holds since cashier C uses different cashier session than B's kiosk Sanctum token)

concurrent_3way_verdict.nf525_correctness: GREEN — single writer to audit_chain_b1 + single allocator on fiscal_seq_b1 in scenario window; chain mathematically uncontested
concurrent_3way_verdict.rush_hour_resilience: GREEN for data/financial; AMBER for UX-friendliness when an Algérienne-class sauce is 86'd mid-cart. With Q9-S1 Echo baseline 1015ms versus the 680ms scenario window, backend is the SOLE active defense — design intent is met (defense-in-depth: backend + client prune + Echo cache flush), but client prune is missing the extras coverage to make the third layer effective in this exact scenario.

The UX gap (L8.1-Q1) is a defer-to-V1.0.X-Wave-M item — owner-decision whether to extend prune coverage now or after first 30-day soak. Recommended: ship one-line lang/fr.json hardening of `kiosk.pay_screen.invalid_order_response` to be more helpful when error_code matches a `Supplément` indispo pattern, while planning the full extras-prune extension.
